english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for physical pain: a body part, injury, or sensation that hurts.
This is the all-purpose choice for ordinary physical pain or tenderness.
Use 痛 when the body part or spot hurts, especially when it is touched or pressed.

examples.english: My foot was stepped on, and it was painful.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 bei2 jan4 caai2 dou2 hou2 tung3

examples.english: My ankle is still tender when someone touches it.
examples.traditional: 我隻腳眼畀人掂到仲好痛。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 ngaan5 bei2 jan4 dim3 dou3 zung6 hou2 tung3
